composition_subtypes.role: Filter managers to keep only those with increasing prefix lengths
Sort the initial prefix of maximum length
Simulate filtered managers by popping from both ends of sorted deque

payload.core_composition_summary: Monotonic stack reduces operations, sort prefix, deque assigns elements.
payload.rationale: Solution combines monotonic stack to filter manager operations, sorting to order the affected prefix, and a deque to efficiently apply remaining sorts from both ends.
